name: player_keeptradecut_value week axis boundary is to_timestamp(week_timestamp), unbounded and unfloored (executed-result parity)
description: The week-axis as-of boundary is `to_timestamp(nfl_year_week_timestamp.week_timestamp)` -- an absolute instant, not a session-TZ-dependent date_trunc like the year axis. Seed one player with three observations straddling the week-1 2023 boundary: one day before it (1000), exactly at it (5000), and 4 hours after it (9999); as-of must resolve to 5000. A boundary shifted a day earlier or later returns 1000; shifted 4 hours later or more returns 9999 -- either failure pins a wrong boundary. A second player carries a single observation 40 days before the boundary with nothing closer: the week axis has no recency floor (unlike the year axis's 30-day window), so this must resolve to that far value rather than NULL -- if a floor were ever added to the week branch, the INNER JOIN would drop this player's row entirely and the fixture would fail on a missing row rather than a wrong value.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2023 AND nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1)), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE pgl.is_active = TRUE AND g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "tec7941fb3bae58990cad0dcc2f4911e6"."keeptradecut_value" AS "player_keeptradecut_value_0", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "nfl_year_week_timestamp" on "nfl_year_week_timestamp"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "nfl_year_week_timestamp"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" inner join "keeptradecut_valuations" as "tec7941fb3bae58990cad0dcc2f4911e6" on "tec7941fb3bae58990cad0dcc2f4911e6"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "tec7941fb3bae58990cad0dcc2f4911e6"."is_superflex" = true and "tec7941fb3bae58990cad0dcc2f4911e6"."observed_at" = (select MAX(observed_at) from "keeptradecut_valuations" where "pid" = player.pid and "is_superflex" = true and "keeptradecut_value" is not null and "observed_at" <= to_timestamp(nfl_year_week_timestamp.week_timestamp)) left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "tec7941fb3bae58990cad0dcc2f4911e6"."keeptradecut_value", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
